description: This file contains helper functions and documentation related to batched tensor processing and 'vmap' plumbing in the PyTorch functorch extension, including functions for creating, unwrapping, and checking batched tensors, as well as internal assertions and level checks.

methods.name: vmap_check_escaped
methods.description: Checks if a dynamic layer has escaped, used for debugging or validation within vmap plumbing.

methods.name: makeBatched
methods.description: Creates a BatchedTensor given a tensor, batching dimension, and level.

methods.name: unwrapTensorAtLevel
methods.description: Unwraps a tensor to its underlying tensor if it matches the specified batched level; otherwise returns the original tensor with nullopt.

methods.name: makeBatchedVector
methods.description: Creates a vector of BatchedTensors from a vector of tensors, a batching dimension, and level.

methods.name: isBatchedAtLevel
methods.description: Checks whether a tensor or list of tensors is batched at a specific level.

methods.name: bool ivalueParticipatesInCurrentLevel(const IValue & ivalue)
methods.description: Determines whether an IValue tensor participates in the current dynamic layer level.
